_meta.about: tvkit knowledge base: what preinstalled Android TV / Google TV packages do and how risky it is to disable them. Tiers are deliberately conservative. Every entry cites where the claim came from (see sources). Live device checks in tvkit (current launcher, keyboard, system-uid, persistent) override anything here.

tiers.protected: Never disabled by tvkit. Disabling breaks core TV functions (inputs, remote, Wi-Fi, updates, boot).
tiers.caution: Works without it for some people, but a feature disappears (voice, casting, launcher, accessibility). tvkit requires --allow-caution plus the user's explicit OK.
tiers.bloat: Ads, promo, telemetry, duplicate stores/browsers. Reasonable to disable if the user doesn't use it.
tiers.optional: A normal app or feature (streaming, media players, screensavers). Disable only if the user never uses it.

sources.cobanov: https://tv.cobanov.dev/en/prompt.txt (keep-list and 'known traps' from an author who debloated a TCL TV with Claude Code; claims, not measurements)
sources.hwbusters: https://hwbusters.com/software/ai-tv-debloating-tcl-98c7k-benchmarks/ (TCL 98C7K, Android TV 14: six apps disabled, measured before/after, no breakage reported)
sources.seun: https://github.com/seun-novodev/android-tv-debloat-toolkit (run_toolkit.py Safe/Caution/Critical ratings and scripts; repo says it is not actively maintained)
sources.cleanyourtv: https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv (PROMPT.md never-disable list, as summarised by developersdigest.tech)
sources.vibehack: https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack (never-disable list, as summarised by explainx.ai)
sources.common: Standard Android / Google TV component; rated conservatively by tvkit without a specific breakage report

protected_keywords._comment: Applied only to system packages that are NOT listed below. Substring matches for long words, whole-segment matches for short ones. Matching unknown packages are treated as protected until researched.

com.android.systemui.label: System UI
com.android.systemui.why: Draws system overlays, volume and notifications.

com.android.shell.label: Shell
com.android.shell.why: Runs ADB commands, including tvkit's own.

com.android.vending.label: Google Play Store
com.android.vending.why: App installs and app security updates.
com.android.vending.breaks: No app updates, including security fixes.

com.google.android.gms.label: Google Play Services
com.google.android.gms.why: Sign-in, casting, Assistant and most Google apps depend on it.

com.google.android.leanback.ime.label: Leanback keyboard
com.google.android.leanback.ime.breaks: No way to type passwords or search.

com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.label: Gboard for TV
com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.why: On-screen keyboard on many Google TVs.
com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.breaks: No way to type passwords or search.

com.google.android.webview.label: Android System WebView
com.google.android.webview.why: Many apps render screens with it.

com.android.webview.label: Android System WebView (AOSP)
com.android.webview.why: Many apps render screens with it.

com.tcl.suspension.label: TCL Inputs/Source menu
com.tcl.suspension.why: The Inputs (Source) menu on the remote.
com.tcl.suspension.breaks: Inputs button dies; you can no longer switch to HDMI.

com.tcl.ttvs.label: TCL system update
com.tcl.ttvs.why: Firmware updates over network/USB. Keep it: firmware updates carry security fixes.
com.tcl.ttvs.breaks: System update menu silently stops working.

com.tcl.initsetup.label: TCL setup wizard
com.tcl.initsetup.why: First-run setup; other parts of the system depend on it.

com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx.label: Google TV Home
com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx.why: The stock Google TV home screen.
com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx.breaks: No home screen if disabled before a replacement is set and verified; some report casting problems without it.

com.google.android.tvlauncher.label: Android TV Home
com.google.android.tvlauncher.why: The stock Android TV home screen.
com.google.android.tvlauncher.breaks: No home screen if disabled before a replacement is set and verified.

com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.label: Android TV Home (legacy)
com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.why: Older stock Android TV home screen.
com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.breaks: No home screen if disabled before a replacement is set.

com.tcl.usercenter2.label: TCL Launcher
com.tcl.usercenter2.why: Labelled 'TCL Launcher' by one toolkit; may be the home screen on TCL Android TV models.

com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith.label: Google TV setup
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith.why: Google TV setup flow; only relevant when swapping launchers because it can take the home screen back.

com.google.android.apps.mediashell.label: Chromecast built-in
com.google.android.apps.mediashell.why: Lets phones cast to the TV.
com.google.android.apps.mediashell.breaks: Casting from phone apps stops working.

com.google.android.marvin.talkback.label: TalkBack
com.google.android.marvin.talkback.why: Screen reader. Unused by most people, essential for some.

com.tcl.gallery.label: TCL Gallery
com.tcl.gallery.why: Photo viewer. HWBusters excluded it because it shares the Android system UID.

com.tcl.eula.label: TCL terms (EULA)
com.tcl.eula.why: Terms acceptance; side effects of disabling are unknown.

com.tcl.browser.label: BrowseHere (TCL browser)
com.tcl.browser.why: Preinstalled web browser. Disabled in the HWBusters test with no breakage.

com.tcl.smartalexa.label: TCL Alexa integration
com.tcl.smartalexa.why: Alexa control. Disabled in the HWBusters test. Keep it if you use Alexa.

com.tcl.magiconnectfree.label: MagiConnect
com.tcl.magiconnectfree.why: Phone remote/media sharing app. Disabled in the HWBusters test.

com.google.android.play.games.label: Google Play Games
com.google.android.play.games.why: Games hub. Disabled in the HWBusters test.

com.iqiyi.i18n.tv.label: iQIYI
com.iqiyi.i18n.tv.why: Streaming app. Disabled in the HWBusters test.

com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic.label: YouTube Music
com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic.why: Music app. Disabled in the HWBusters test.

me.efesser.flauncher.label: FLauncher
me.efesser.flauncher.why: Lightweight open-source replacement launcher. Don't disable it while it is your Home app.

com.spocky.projengmenu.label: Projectivy Launcher
com.spocky.projengmenu.why: Customisable replacement launcher. Don't disable it while it is your Home app.
